final:

Unix timestamp: 2026-01-01 00:00:00 UTC = 1767225600. January has 31 days, February 2026 has 28 days (2026 is not a leap year). So 2026-03-01 = 1767225600 + (31+28)*86400 = 1767225600 + 59*86400 = 1767225600 + 5097600 = 1772323200. Yes.

"Created before March 2026" means the created timestamp is less than 1772323200 (2026-03-01 00:00:00 UTC).
